$comment: Font families the free-text tools offer (M30). The `base` list is the standard 14 under the names a reader knows them by: those need no embedding and render the same everywhere. `suggested` names families the picker shows above the system list when the machine has them — chosen because PDFium's substitution table (resources/fonts/substitutions.json) already knows what to draw them with. Nothing here is embedded; see docs/adr/0013.
